title: Smith's memo to the PSB on 1,500 UFO reports

tellings.quote: Another document, this time from Smith to the director of the Psychological Strategy Board, notes that over 1,500 UFO reports had been logged.

plain: In 1952 an official named Walter B. Smith sent a CIA memo to the head of the Psychological Strategy Board, a Washington body that worked on psychological strategy, noting that more than 1,500 UFO reports had been logged. Michels cites the memo himself, as one of several documents showing how seriously the government was taking the sightings.
